description: This PHP source file defines the class 'BuzzEmbeddedURL' which is responsible for generating and validating embedded URLs for videos (YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion) based on a provided URL. It manages internal state and attempts to produce embedded URLs by delegating to specialized classes.

classes.name: BuzzEmbeddedURL
classes.description: Represents an embedded URL for a video, capable of generating an embedded URL from a standard URL and validating it.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a URL.

methods.name: setEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Sets the embedded URL and updates internal state to indicate the URL has been generated.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Attempts to generate and return an embedded URL based on the original URL by checking multiple video platforms.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Checks if the current URL can produce a valid embedded URL.
